title: One Federation selective disclosure
description: Selective-disclosure request (in a query) and presentation (in an answer) of person attributes using SD-JWT VC with key binding (RFC 9901). A presentation is not authority; on the receiving side it only feeds an acceptance record.

request.description: The least set of attributes asked for. No purpose text: constraints are shared, reasons are not.

vct.description: Verifiable credential type of the credential the attributes come from.

claims.description: Names of the claims to disclose (for example an age-over threshold claim rather than a birth date).

presentation.description: An SD-JWT+KB in compact form: issuer-signed JWT, the disclosures of exactly the requested claims, and a key-binding JWT whose `aud` is the requesting agent and whose `nonce` is the query's messageId.
